description: This file defines a PHP class 'MySQL57Platform' that extends the Doctrine DBAL's MySQL57Platform class. It overrides the hasNativeJsonType() method to indicate that this platform does not support native JSON type, which may be specific to MySQL 5.7. The file resides within a namespace related to command utilities for database platforms in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: MySQL57Platform
classes.description: A custom platform class for MySQL 5.7 that indicates the absence of native JSON support.

methods.name: hasNativeJsonType
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return false, indicating that native JSON type is not supported on this platform.
